mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_tbl (userId, title, content, postCodeId, createAt) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{postCodeId}, NOW());
mapper.select:
SELECT p.postId as p_postId, p.userId as p_userId, u.nickName as u_nickName, p.title as p_title, p.content as p_content, p.createAt as p_createAt, p.viewCount as p_viewCount, p.postCodeId as p_postCodeId, pc.category as pc_category, p.like_count as p_like_count, p.dislike_count as p_dislike_count,a.postAttachmentId as a_postAttachmentId, a.postId as a_postId, a.userId as a_userId, a.attachmentUrl as a_attachmentUrl, a.originalFileName as a_originalFileName, a.contentType as a_contentType
FROM post_tbl p JOIN user_tbl u ON p.userId = u.userId JOIN postCode_tbl pc ON p.postCodeId = pc.postCodeId LEFT JOIN postAttachment_tbl a ON p.postId = a.postId WHERE p.postId = #{postId}
SELECT postAttachmentId, postId, userId, attachmentUrl, originalFileName, contentType FROM postAttachment_tbl WHERE postId = #{postId};
SELECT postRecommendationId, postId, userId, reactionType, createAt FROM postRecommendation_tbl WHERE postId = #{postId} AND userId = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO postRecommendation_tbl (postRecommendationId, postId, userId, reactionType, createAt) VALUES (#{postRecommendationId}, #{postId}, #{userId}, #{reactionType}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM postRecommendation_tbl WHERE postId = #{postId} AND userId = #{userId}
